summary: Builds an FPU exception context record (exception-type bitfield, control-word and status-word derived flag words, two double operands with classification flags) from a decoded exception-code bitmask, FPU status/control information and the two double operands, calls RaiseException to signal the exception, then reads the context back to update the caller's output parameters (precision/rounding mode and status bits) and return the context base.

operations.description: zero-initialize context fields: exception-type bitfield (+4), control-word flag word (+8), status-word flag word (+C)
decode dwExceptionCode bitmask: each of bits 0x10/0x2/0x1/0x4/0x8 selects a distinct Win32 FPU exception code and sets the corresponding bit in the exception-type bitfield (+4)
encode rounding/precision/underflow flags derived from *a2 into the control-word flag word (+8)
call ShortComputation_1e49() and map its returned status/control bits into the status-word flag word (+C)
decode precision-control bits (*a2 & 0xC00: 0x0/1024/2048/3072) into context flag bits 0-1
decode rounding-control bits (*a2 & 0x300: 0x0/512/768) into context flag bits 3-5
write (a4 & 0xFFF) into context flag word bits 5-15 (exception/control mask)
store first double operand *a5 into context +16 and set its classification flags at +32
store second double operand *a6 into context +64 and set its classification flags at +80
call FPUStatusWordRead() to read the current x87 status word (result not used directly; status is conveyed through the context)
call RaiseException(dwExceptionCode, 0, 1, &Arguments) to raise the FPU exception with the populated context record
after the raise returns, clear FPU exception bits in *a2 for flags set in the control-word flag word (+8)
decode the precision encoding written in context flag word (+0) back into *a2 bits
decode the rounding mode written in context flag word (+0) back into *a2 bits
copy the second-operand result from context +64 back into *a6
return the context base (Arguments) holding the exception-record-style structure
